full_page.content:
1946, June 22
The following is a faithful transcription of words of advice written in longhand by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap. on the first page of each of the four books of "The Mystical City of God."
Book No. I.
"A Treasury of Wisdom Divine that should be prayed rather than simply read." Blessed by Fr. Solanus, O.F.M Cap., poor Sinner. June 22, 1946. Book No. II.
"If Artists can be known by their Masterpieces, what better way can there be of learning to know God than by studying His own blessed Immaculate Mother, the Masterpiece of all divine Masterpieces?" Father Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. "Sinner."
Book No. III.
"Dear Reader: To know is to appreciate." Next to the sorrows of Jesus and the inexhaustible Love of His Sacred Heart, the sorrows of Mary and the love that filled her soul, surpass comprehension. At times in the course of the following pages, one can only wonder as at a manifest miracle, the fact that Mary survived the bitter Passion of Jesus. She did survive him for more than fifteen years -- Mother and mistress and Queen ofthe Apostles -- next to Jesus Himself most meek and humble of heart; next to Him also, most compassionate and gentle. Would that Mary were better known! Would that her sorrows were better appreciated! How much better Jesus Himself would then be known! How much better loved! Praised be Jesus and Mary, His Sorrowful Mother!" Father Solanus, O.M.Cap. Pray for the Poor Sinner.
Book No. IV.
Dear Reader :- "The following pages treat on the "finishing touches" whereby God Himself glorified the Masterpiece of His own works -- Crowned His Immaculate Mother Mary. Learn to know that you may appreciate." Fr. Solanus O.F.M.Cap.
Original Volumes Possession of: Mrs. Joseph O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois 60611
